name: Grameva Limited
about: Grameva Limited engages in the trading of agro products in India. The company also produces, stores, and markets various agro products. In addition, the company trades in jute products. The company was formerly known as Bangalore Fort Farms Limited and changed its name to Grameva Limited in November 2025. Grameva Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Kolkata, India.
